gloss: reserved; chartered; exclusive rental; private hire

definitions.gloss: reserved; chartered; exclusive rental; private hire
definitions.explanation: renting something exclusively for one's own use, such as a bus, venue, or facility

examples.japanese: {貸|か}し{切|き}りバスで{遠足|えんそく}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: We're going on a field trip by chartered bus.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}はレストランを{貸|か}し{切|き}りにした。
examples.english: We reserved the restaurant exclusively for today.

examples.japanese: {貸|か}し{切|き}り{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}でのんびりした。
examples.english: I relaxed in a private open-air bath.

notes:
FORMATION:
{貸|か}す (to lend/rent) + {切|き}る (completely) → exclusive rental

COMMON USES:
- {貸|か}し{切|き}りバス (chartered bus)
- {貸|か}し{切|き}り{電車|でんしゃ} (chartered train)
- {貸|か}し{切|き}り{風呂|ふろ} (private bath)
- {貸|か}し{切|き}り{会場|かいじょう} (private venue)
- {貸|か}し{切|き}りパーティー (private party)

VERB FORM:
- {貸|か}し{切|き}る (to charter, reserve exclusively)
- {貸|か}し{切|き}りにする (to make it a private rental)

USAGE:
Also used as a na-adjective: {貸|か}し{切|き}りの (exclusively reserved)

ONSEN CONTEXT:
{貸|か}し{切|き}り{風呂|ふろ} (private bath) is a popular service at Japanese hot spring resorts, allowing guests to use a bath privately.

RELATED:
- チャーター (charter)
- {予約|よやく} (reservation)
- {専用|せんよう} (exclusive use)
